newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Air delays start of Seattle-Maui service.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Air delays start of Seattle-Maui service.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc, citing soft market conditions, on Tuesday it was delaying the start of its new non-stop service between Seattle and Maui, Hawaii, until February 15.
In a statement, the carrier said the twice-weekly service had been scheduled to start on January 18.
Peter Jenkins, Hawaiian's senior vice president for marketing and sales, said the move reflects "unseasonably soft market demand" in the Pacific Northwest early in the first quarter.
Customers booked on the new flights traveling before February 15 will be accommodated on the airline's Seattle-Honolulu service with connections to Maui via an Island Shuttle service.
